picks.why: Kenneth Walker has 290 rush yards plus 79 receiving yards in weeks 1-2, 184.5 rush-plus-rec per game against a 109.5 line. Even a drop to Miami's 3.95 YPC on 20 carries (~79) plus his 39.5 receiving yards per game is about 118.5, still over 109.5, and Miami's 6 runs of 10+ plus a 41% blitz match the 16 targets and 11 air yards already on his sheet.

Travis Kelce has 172 yards on 16 targets, 86.0 per game versus a 52.5 line, and Miami is allowing 11.27 YPA in the middle on 15 attempts against 6.67 on the right (15 attempts). Patrick Mahomes at 0.36 EPA versus Miami's 41% blitz is the mechanism, and Kelce is the target leader in that 16-target sample.
